scenes.text: Michelangelo did not paint the Sistine Chapel ceiling lying on his back.
He and his helpers stood upright on wooden scaffolding and painted above their heads.
The lying-down image mostly comes from a nineteen sixty-five Hollywood movie.
The work took about four years, from fifteen oh eight to fifteen twelve.
And the finished ceiling was first shown to the public on November first, fifteen twelve.
That's five hundred and fourteen years ago tomorrow.
Did you believe the lying-down version too?

title: Michelangelo didn't paint lying down 🎨
caption: Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling standing on scaffolding, not on his back. The ceiling was first shown to the public on November 1, 1512. 🎨
